collection.title: Mercedes-Benz CLK 1997 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz CLK Coupe 1997 to 2002 (C208) model requires a 24" wiper blade. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
